title: Costs
description: What services, applications, teams and platforms cost per month – from the platforms Steward reads and imported FOCUS files. Showback, not invoices.
hiddenHint: Amounts are shown to owners, members of the owning teams, administrators and auditors. You see the changes and budget states.
hiddenHintOne: Amounts are shown to the owners, the members of the owning teams, administrators and auditors. You see the changes and the budget's state.

empty.title: No costs yet
empty.who: Whoever may manage a platform turns on reading its costs, or imports a FOCUS file, under Costs → Platforms → the platform → Source.
empty.service: No service has costs yet: costs reach a service through its applications.
empty.application: No application has costs yet: a tag on the costs (default “application”) or a platform that belongs to the application links them.
empty.team: No team has costs yet: a team has the costs of the applications and platforms it owns.
empty.platform: No platform has costs yet. Steward reads AWS, Snowflake, Confluent Cloud and LLM gateways, and imports FOCUS files of other providers.

settings.title: Cost settings
settings.hideHint: Only owners, members of the owning teams, administrators and auditors see amounts; everybody else sees changes in percent and budget states.
settings.currencyHint: For LLM gateways without their own currency
settings.noConversion: Amounts are never converted between currencies: totals are per currency.
settings.fiscalYearHint: One start month for the whole instance; the service cost plans use it. Changing it later moves every plan into the new fiscal-year boundaries – choose it once.

fiscalYearChange.title: Change the fiscal year start?
fiscalYearChange.message: Every plan is then read in the new fiscal-year boundaries: plan lines keep their fiscal year, cost entries count in the year their date falls in.
fiscalYearChange.otherYear_one: {{count}} cost entry then falls into another fiscal year than its plan line. The link stays; the entry counts as unplanned in its year and can be linked to a plan line of that year.
fiscalYearChange.otherYear_other: {{count}} cost entries then fall into another fiscal year than their plan line. The links stay; the entries count as unplanned in their year and can be linked to a plan line of that year.

detailHint.service: The costs of the service's applications, per month and currency.
detailHint.application: The costs linked to the application, per month and currency.
detailHint.team: The costs of the applications the team owns, and what its platforms have unassigned.
detailHint.platform: Everything read or imported for this platform, also what no application is linked to.

none.title: No costs here yet
none.who: Whoever may manage a platform reads its costs or imports a FOCUS file; the tag (default “application”) links them to applications.
none.service: None of the service's applications has costs linked to it.
none.application: No costs are linked to this application – check the tag of its cloud accounts and the FOCUS files.
none.team: No application or platform of the team has costs yet.
none.platform: Nothing was read or imported for this platform yet.

unassigned.title: Unassigned
unassigned.hint: Costs that no application is linked to: no tag, a tag no component or application has, or a platform no application owns.

budget.title: Monthly budget
budget.stateOnly: Only the budget's state is shown: some applications are hidden from you, and the budget covers them all.
budget.forecast: Forecast for the month: {{pct}} % of the budget
budget.dialogHint: The owners hear about it at 80 % and 100 %. A budget stops nothing – it is showback.
budget.raiseHint: This raises the budget (a higher amount, another currency, or none): you confirm it is you.

how.aws: UnblendedCost per month by the application tag and by service – once a day, as each request costs $0.01.
how.snowflake: USAGE_IN_CURRENCY_DAILY of the organisation's usage views; without them the credits of METERING_DAILY_HISTORY times your price per credit. Once a day.
how.confluent: Daily lines per cluster, connector and product in US dollars, at most a month per request, complete after 72 hours. Once a day.
how.ai: The costs of the calls from the prices set on the models, per day, model and process. Every hour.
how.focus: This platform has no cost connector: import the FOCUS files its provider exports, or push them from CI.

enabledHint.aws: The cloud-account components of applications read the costs as well.
enabledHint.snowflake: Read with the rights of who saves this.
enabledHint.confluent: The Cloud API key needs the OrganizationAdmin or BillingAdmin role.
enabledHint.ai: From Steward's own usage log – no call to the gateway.

source.tagKeyHint: Its value is the name of a component on this platform or of an application
source.creditPriceHint: Only used without the organisation's usage views
source.aiCurrencyHint: The currency of the prices on the models; empty: the cost settings' currency

import.title: FOCUS files
import.help: CSV files in the FinOps FOCUS format (AWS Data Exports, Azure cost exports, Google Cloud and others), up to {{max}}. You see a preview first.
import.notRead: The file could not be read
import.mapping: Lines linked to applications: {{assigned}}, unassigned: {{unassigned}} · Providers: {{providers}}
import.replaceHint_one: Replaces {{count}} line of earlier imports for the same days (a corrected file). Changes of closed days are recorded as corrections.
import.replaceHint_other: Replaces {{count}} lines of earlier imports for the same days (a corrected file). Changes of closed days are recorded as corrections.
import.addHint: Keeps every earlier line – for files of other accounts for the same days.
import.noneHint: Imports are listed here with their SHA-256, period and who imported them.

push.title: Push from CI
push.help: A push token can do nothing but send FOCUS files for this platform to Steward. It is shown once; only its hash is kept.
push.emptyHint: Create one for the job that exports your FOCUS files.
push.name: Name
push.creatorInactive: Stopped: its creator may no longer manage the platform
push.rotateConfirm: Give “{{name}}” a new secret? The old one stops working at once.
push.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{{name}}”? Pushes with it are refused from now on.
push.addressesHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges of your CI runners
push.secretOnce: Copy the token now – Steward keeps only its hash and cannot show it again.

plan.title: Cost plan
plan.help: What the service plans to spend on the systems and solutions it uses and on support, per fiscal year, and what it incurred. Internal to the service – no person-hours, no invoice processing. The monthly budget of the costs pages is separate.
plan.amountsHidden: Amounts are shown to the owners, the members of the owning teams, administrators and auditors.
plan.cloudHidden: Cloud and platform costs were read for this service, but you do not see all of its applications, so they are not shown here – the figures cover the service's other costs only.
plan.readLine: Cloud and platform (read, no plan line): {{soFar}} so far, {{expected}} expected for the year
plan.unplannedLine_one: {{count}} unplanned entry: {{soFar}} so far, {{all}} in the year
plan.unplannedLine_other: {{count}} unplanned entries: {{soFar}} so far, {{all}} in the year
plan.targetGone: no longer part of the service

groups.none: Not tied to an application or system

read.matchedHint: This cloud line takes the costs Steward reads for its application or platform: the months that are over count as incurred, the current month as its forecast.
read.hiddenHint: You do not see every application of the service, so the costs read are not shown.
read.takenHint: An older cloud line for the same application or platform and currency takes the costs read; this line counts its entries only.

targetHidden.application: An application you may not see
targetHidden.system: A system you may not see
targetHidden.platform: A platform you may not see

empty.title: No plan for {{label}} yet
empty.who: Whoever may change the service adds plan lines and cost entries.
empty.body: Plan the licences, cloud, service and support, hardware and other costs of the service for the fiscal year, and record what was incurred.

copy.title: Copy the plan
copy.message: Copy every plan line of {{from}} into {{to}}? Renewal dates before the new year move on by a year. Entries are not copied.
copy.result: Copied to {{to}}: {{copied}} line(s) ({{shortened}} up to their contract's end), {{proposed}} payment schedule(s) proposed, {{leftOut}} left out (contract ended)

line.removeWithEntries_one: Remove the plan line “{{title}}”? Its {{count}} entry stays and counts as unplanned.
line.removeWithEntries_other: Remove the plan line “{{title}}”? Its {{count}} entries stay and count as unplanned.

form.title: Title
form.forHint: An application or system of the service (a platform for cloud lines)
form.noTarget: Not tied to an application or system
form.cloudHint: A cloud line for an application or platform is compared with the costs Steward reads for it (the platform: the share of the service's applications).
form.vendorHint: Free text, e.g. the vendor and the contract number
form.noEffort: Costs only: effort and person-hours are not planned here.

partOfYearHint.monthly: The amount in each month from the first to the last
partOfYearHint.quarterly: The amount every third month from the first month, up to the last
partOfYearHint.yearly: The amount is what the line costs in these months, spread evenly over them

form.toBeforeFrom: The end is before the start
form.prepaidHint: Counted in the fiscal year it is paid; later years it covers show it as prepaid
form.renewalFromContract: Renewals of a contract line are the contract's notice-by date and term end.

entries.title: Cost entries
entries.none: No cost entries in this fiscal year.

entry.lineHint: A plan line of {{label}} in the same currency; none: unplanned
entry.supplierHint: Default: the plan line's supplier and contract

team.title: Plans of the team's services
team.hint: The cost plans of the services the team owns, per currency. A service of several teams counts for each of them.
team.none: None of the team's services has a plan for {{label}}.

plan.costsReadHint: The costs Steward reads from the platforms for this service, month by month
plan.supplierHidden: A supplier you may not see

book.title: Book: {{title}}
book.help: Records that this payment was made. Steward never books on its own: an entry says money was spent.

schedules.title: Payments
schedules.none: No payment schedule yet. Add one to propose this contract's plan lines per fiscal year.
schedules.removeConfirm: Remove the payment schedule “{{title}}” of {{service}}? Plan lines made from it stay as ordinary lines.

form.title: Title
form.titleHint: e.g. Base fee, Setup, Additional users
form.serviceHint: The service whose cost plan gets the lines
form.yearAmountsHint: Contract years count from the start in twelve-month steps. A year without an amount takes the year before.
form.paymentsInvalid: Each payment needs a date and an amount with the currency's decimals.
form.noProRata: A payment counts in the month of its date – no pro rata. Enter a first invoice billed pro rata as a dated payment.
form.platformHint: The platform's own cost plan gets the lines; it must be covered by the contract

contractLines.toPlanHelp: Payment schedules of this service with payments in this fiscal year and no lines for it yet. Nothing is added until you confirm.
contractLines.hiddenContract: {{title}} (a contract of a supplier you may not see)
contractLines.changedHelp: The contract or its payments changed since these lines were made. Choose the changes to apply; years that are over stay as planned.
contractLines.goneWithEntries_one: Line removed – its {{count}} entry becomes unplanned
contractLines.goneWithEntries_other: Line removed – its {{count}} entries become unplanned
contractLines.unlinkPending: Saving makes this an ordinary line without contract hints.

commitments.title: Commitments
commitments.description: What supplier contracts still owe under their payment schedules, per fiscal year and currency.
commitments.warnings_one: {{count}} notice date before an unplanned year
commitments.empty: No payment schedules here. Add payments to a supplier contract to see what it still owes.
commitments.hiddenContract: A contract of a supplier you may not see
commitments.hiddenDates: The dates of a contract you may not see are not shown
commitments.totalExit: To the earliest exit {{amount}} · this fiscal year {{thisYear}}
commitments.help: The contracts this plan pays, from their payment schedules: what is still owed from today, to contract end and to the earliest exit (the end of the term after the next notice-by date). Entries are not subtracted; a volume owes only what is committed.
commitments.noneForService: No payment schedules for this service yet.
commitments.supplierHelp: The payment schedules of this supplier's contracts for services you may see, what they still owe, and what was incurred with the supplier.
commitments.note: Commitments are the scheduled payments of contracts dated today or later – not liabilities, not accounting. Totals are per currency and only count amounts you may see.

entryImport.title: Import entries (CSV)
entryImport.help: For invoice lists and ERP exports: UTF-8, separated by commas, semicolons or tabs, with a header row. Map the columns, check the preview, then import the rows without problems in one step – all or nothing. At most 5 MB and 5,000 rows.
entryImport.fileHint: The preview stores nothing; the file is read again on import.
entryImport.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
entryImport.decimalHint: The other one is read as a thousands separator
entryImport.mappingIncomplete: Choose the date and amount columns, the date format, the decimal separator and a currency.
entryImport.previewFailed: The file could not be read
entryImport.counts: {{rows}} rows: {{ready}} ready, {{problems}} with problems, {{duplicates}} duplicates (left out unless ticked)

problems.badDate: Not a date in the chosen format
problems.decimals: More decimals than the currency has
problems.planLineOtherYear: Plan line of another fiscal year
problems.supplierUnknown: Unknown supplier, or one you may not see
problems.contractUnknown: Unknown contract, or one you may not see
problems.contractNotCovering: The contract does not cover this service, and you may not add the service to it
problems.limit: Over the limit of entries per fiscal year

entryImport.removeConfirm_one: Remove the import of {{name}}? Its {{count}} entry that is still there goes.
entryImport.removeConfirm_other: Remove the import of {{name}}? Its {{count}} entries that are still there go.

platformPlan.help: What the platform team plans to spend per fiscal year on the platform's own contracts – capacity, a cloud spend commitment, a subscription – set against the platform's whole bill as Steward reads it, plus the cost entries. Its costs are not allocated to the services that use the platform.
platformPlan.readLine: The platform's costs (read) no line takes: {{soFar}} so far, {{expected}} expected for the year.
platformPlan.cloudHint: A line of category Cloud takes the platform's costs read in its currency (the oldest such line); a volume billed by use from the read costs takes those of its months first.

volumes.title: Volumes
volumes.help: Contract volumes this plan pays: what the current period used, what is left and – an estimate at the rate of the recent months – where it ends. A prepaid volume covers the use until it is used up; that use is not counted as incurred again.
volumes.estimateNote: Estimates are linear: the use per day of the last 90 days times the days left. They change when the use does.
volumes.drawnLine: Drawn from prepaid volumes: {{soFar}} so far – shown, not counted again (the payment is the cost).
volumes.bookHelp: A volume billed by use is booked with the amount of the invoice. The average use per month so far in the period is filled in as a start.

consumption.read: Use from the platform's read costs

warnings.runsOut: Runs out before the period ends (estimate)

volumes.tooEarly: No estimate yet: less than 28 days of use.
volumes.stateOnly: The use counts services or platforms you may not see: warnings only.
volumes.upTo: Up to {{amount}} more may be billed
volumes.upToTotal: Volumes may bill up to {{amount}} more – not owed

form.amountHint: Contract year 1, or the whole term
form.help: The contract names an amount that may or may not be used in full. Prepaid: paid up front at the start of each period, then drawn down. By use: billed from what is used; choose what is committed.

billingOptions.byUse: By use (billed from what is used)

committedOptions.full: The full volume (use it or lose it)
committedOptions.minimum: A minimum – the rest is an upper limit

form.consumptionHint: The platform's read costs, or the cost entries booked to the contract – one of them, never both.

attribution.title: Costs and contracts

help.application: The services plan and pay; this shows what they attribute to the application – each line, entry and schedule once, also when several services use it.
help.system: The services plan and pay; this shows what they attribute to the system – each line, entry and schedule once, also when several services use it.

attribution.amountsHidden: Some amounts are hidden from you and are not in the totals.

empty.application: No contract, plan line or cost entry names this application.
empty.system: No contract, plan line or cost entry names this system.
